headlines.title: Luigi Mangione admits to killing CEO
headlines.description: Luigi Mangione pleaded guilty in federal court to stalking charges. He also admitted that he shot United Healthcare CEO Brian Thompson, but did not express remorse for the crime. NBC News’ Stephanie Gosk reports.

headlines.title: ‘Revenge is inevitable’: Iran ramps up propaganda war with violent billboards
headlines.description: Anti-U.S. messaging has intensified in recent weeks following the death of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, with artificial intelligence playing a major role.

headlines.title: Iran rejects ‘delusions’ after Trump says he wants the Strait of Hormuz to be a U.S. territory
headlines.description: Iran called on the U.S. to “accept the reality of defeat” after President Donald Trump said he would declare the Strait of Hormuz a “territory” of the U.S.

headlines.description: A pop star hits back at the White House, a total eclipse blankets much of Europe, and a dating app makes a big change.

headlines.title: DATELINE WEEKEND MYSTERY SNEAK PEEK: Deadly Detour
headlines.description: When a prominent attorney claims to have accidentally shot his wealthy wife, the local prosecutor questions his story. Josh Mankiewicz reports Saturday, August 15 at 10/9c on NBC.

headlines.title: Magnitude-7.7 quake hits off coast of Indonesia, killing at least 38
headlines.description: A magnitude-7.7 earthquake hit off the coast of Indonesia in the eastern Flores region, the United States Geological Survey reported on Friday.

headlines.title: Jason Arday, ex-Cambridge professor accused of plagiarism, found dead a week after resigning
headlines.description: Former Cambridge professor Jason Arday was found dead at his London home on Friday, one week after he resigned from his position after accusations of plagiarism.
